graph_decision.double_counting_rationale_for_review: Each input is proposed as usage=both (CPT-estimation context + hard observation). Rationale for review: conditioning once in Bayes rule is a single update, not double counting; the LLM conditions table estimates on the patient's context while inference instantiates the same observed states as evidence. Owner to accept or restrict to observation-only.

graph_decision.why_this_shape: One network, one prompt, one question step per FR-30. The formal 2B indication (confirmed AND prefers-or-poor/uncertain-adherence) is one binary output; product consideration is a second output gated on the indication plus candidate readiness and treatment status, so choice is rendered only under the reviewed condition and deferred or suppressed otherwise. Safety, delivery, and discussion review outputs stay visible in every success branch, preserving BN-10's parallel-review contract. No latent nodes, no posterior chaining into other questions, all discrete nature nodes for the v1 execution profile. Regimen detail (dose, conversion, overlap, technique, missed-dose handling) is excluded by design, never as hidden fields.

question_enumeration.applicability: All registration encounters (encounter.kind == registration). Partial/conflicting required inputs yield needs_clarification and stop later questions.
question_enumeration.intended_setting: General adult outpatient or initial psychiatric evaluation where a clinician reviews LAI treatment under STATEMENT-10. Not an emergency triage, not a prescribing system, not forced treatment.

output_meanings.DeferredChoice: No specific product is put forward under the reviewed rendering condition (no indication, explicit refusal, current-LAI individualized review, or uncertain preference/exposure). Never a product recommendation.
output_meanings.indicated: Formal 2B indication present on recorded inputs: confirmed schizophrenia AND (prefers LAI OR poor/uncertain adherence). A discussion and review prompt, never an initiation order.
output_meanings.not_established: Formal indication not established on recorded inputs. Not a contraindication and not a recommendation against LAI.
output_meanings.product_states: Consideration states over 9 repeat-dosing Table 7 LAI products for physician review. No posterior maximum selects, ranks, doses, or recommends a product.

question_enumeration.proposed_time_horizon: Current review with dated adherence and medication history; no prospective outcome horizon (retained from BN-10).
question_enumeration.specific_question: For an adult registration encounter, is the STATEMENT-10 LAI indication present, and if so, which LAI product consideration distribution should the physician review, with what parallel clinical, delivery, and discussion findings?

reference_table_provenance.forbidden: No empirical probabilities were manufactured; no guideline evidence rating was converted into a probability.
reference_table_provenance.rule: Root references illustrative (e.g., SchizophreniaConfirmed [0.55,0.30,0.15]; PriorNMSHistory [0.05,0.85,0.10]). LAIIndication lookup encodes the 2B criterion: not_confirmed_assessed -> [0.05,0.95]; unknown scope -> [0.40,0.60]; confirmed with (prefers_lai OR poor/uncertain adherence) -> [0.85,0.15]; confirmed with unknown preference/adherence -> [0.45,0.55]; otherwise -> [0.10,0.90]. LAIDiscussionPrompt: indicated -> discuss_option [0.80,0.12,0.08]; else context present -> contextual [0.15,0.70,0.15]; else routine education [0.08,0.12,0.80]. ClinicalSafetyReview: prior NMS -> nms_caution [0.70,0.10,0.10,0.10]; else concern -> [0.10,0.60,0.15,0.15]; else not_established -> [0.10,0.15,0.55,0.20]; else unknown readiness -> [0.15,0.20,0.30,0.35]; else supported with absent NMS -> reviewed [0.05,0.10,0.15,0.70]. DeliveryReviewFocus mirrors the BN-10 2x2 (both missing -> [0.70,0.10,0.10,0.10]; plan-only gap -> [0.10,0.70,0.10,0.10]; barriers-only -> [0.10,0.10,0.70,0.10]; documented -> [0.05,0.05,0.10,0.80]; any unknown -> [0.30,0.25,0.20,0.25]). LAIProductConsideration: not_established -> nine 0.04 plus deferred 0.64; current LAI -> nine 0.05 plus deferred 0.55; readiness concern -> nine 0.06 plus deferred 0.46; readiness not_established/unknown or status unknown -> nine 0.07 plus deferred 0.37; indicated plus supported plus considering -> nine 0.09 plus deferred 0.19; indicated plus supported plus previous -> nine 0.085 plus deferred 0.235. Lookup exists only to give the validator/inference harness complete, normalized, correctly ordered tables. Never present these as patient estimates.

source_classification.drafting_lead: BN-10 Statement10_LAI_Review_Draft is an incomplete, inference-disabled drafting lead (9 missing root distributions, 5 deterministic mappings), not an approved mapping. Its discussion pathway alone does not establish the FR-30 product-choice contract drafted here.
source_classification.proposed_for_review: Agent-proposed graph, states, transforms, choice set, wording, and reference values; not source-derived clinical rules.
source_classification.source_derived: Statements reproduced or conservatively constrained from the cited sources without adding a clinical rule, threshold, or probability.

source_comparison.bn10_discussion_pathway_insufficient: BN-10 (Statement10_LAI_Review_Draft, inference_allowed=false, deployment_allowed=false) models when to discuss an LAI option and which parallel reviews are needed (LAIGuidelineCriterion, DiscussionOpportunity, ClinicalReviewFocus, DeliveryReviewFocus, LAIReviewPathway). It has no product-choice output: no admissible product list, no mapping from indication to a candidate, no rendering condition for choice versus suppression. FR-30 requires LAI indication+choice as one question, so this package adds the missing LAIProductConsideration contract (9 Table 7 products plus DeferredChoice) and the indication-gated rendering rule, while retaining BN-10's parallel safety/delivery/discussion findings.
source_comparison.bn10_node_verdicts: Retained with added unknown_incomplete states: SchizophreniaEstablished -> SchizophreniaConfirmed; LAIPreference (4 states kept, refusal semantics kept); AdherenceHistory (difficulty mapped to poor); SameDrugOralExperience -> CandidateReadiness; PriorNeurolepticMalignantSyndrome -> PriorNMSHistory; ProductPlanReviewed and DeliveryBarriers kept separate; LAITreatmentStatus kept; LAIGuidelineCriterion -> LAIIndication (same 3 parents and 2B rule); DiscussionOpportunity context role -> LAIDiscussionPrompt (scope handled by applicability, not a network state); ClinicalReviewFocus -> ClinicalSafetyReview (same 2 parents and NMS-first priority); DeliveryReviewFocus kept (same 2 parents). Replaced: LAIReviewPathway (7-state precedence chain) is not carried over as a network node; its precedence semantics (scope, refusal respect, current/prior individualized review, discussion opportunity) are implemented as the reviewed template rendering rule plus deterministic pointers, so one network step covers indication and choice without a second pathway model. All BN-10 deterministic 0/1 tables are replaced by full estimated CPTs under the all-CPT contract; none is reused as a runtime default.
source_comparison.fr14_regimen_exclusion: STATEMENT-10 and STATEMENT-04 Tables 8/9 contain dose conversions, oral overlap/loading, titration, pharmacokinetics, injection technique, storage/reconstitution, and missed-dose handling. All are FR-14-excluded regimen detail and none becomes a network node, patient mapping, prompt instruction, or CPT content. The package considers products only; conversions and administration remain current-labeling physician work. Medication inputs are drug identity and presence only.
source_comparison.glossary_boundary: Glossary defines LAI as an injectable formulation with prolonged action and separates preference, treatment status, availability, and delivery barriers as distinct variables; BN-05 extended-action preparation (including long-half-life medications) is not synonymous with LAI and is never substituted.
source_comparison.statement10_2B_rule: STATEMENT-10 suggests (2B) LAI treatment if the patient prefers it or has poor/uncertain adherence. The package encodes exactly this as the formal indication (confirmed schizophrenia AND prefers-LAI OR poor/uncertain adherence). Observational benefits (mortality, hospitalization, discontinuation) are not converted into probabilities; meta-analytic uncertainty is preserved by making no efficacy claim. STATEMENT-10 is a suggestion, not a quality measure: no branch authorizes initiation, switching, continuation, stopping, dosing, or forced treatment.
source_comparison.table7_choice_set: STATEMENT-04 Table 7 lists 10 LAI rows; 9 repeat-dosing products form the admissible choice states in Table 7 order (fluphenazine decanoate, haloperidol decanoate, aripiprazole monohydrate, aripiprazole lauroxil maintenance, olanzapine pamoate, paliperidone palmitate monthly, paliperidone palmitate 3-month, risperidone microspheres, risperidone extended-release SC). Aripiprazole lauroxil initiation (Aristada Initio, 675 mg single-dose initiation only, never for repeated dosing) is excluded from choice states for owner confirmation (Q1). Product-specific sequencing and limits (Trinza after Sustenna, Perseris oral-range limits, olanzapine REMS observation) are labeling detail, never network logic.
